abilities.name: Leader
abilities.text: This model can be attached to one of the following units: Kabalite Warriors, Kabalite Trueborn, Incubi.

abilities.name: Shadow Field
abilities.text: This model has a 3+ Invulnerable Save. The first time this model fails an Invulnerable save in any phase, its Invulnerable save is permanently reduced to 6+ for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: Supreme Overlord [AURA]
abilities.text: While a friendly Drukhari unit is within 6" of this model, that unit re-rolls Hit rolls of 1, and while wholly within your opponent's deployment zone, also re-rolls Wound rolls of 1.

abilities.name: Master of Combat Drugs
abilities.text: In your Command phase, you may select one Combat Drug for this model and any unit it leads (instead of rolling randomly). The chosen drug applies until your next Command phase, and the unit gains +1 to Wound rolls for the entire duration (in addition to the drug's normal effects).

abilities.name: Eternal Spite
abilities.text: Each time this model would lose its last wound, roll one D6: on a 5+, this model is not destroyed and instead has its remaining Wounds set to 1. This ability cannot trigger more than once per battle.

composition: 1 Asdrubael Vect model. This model is equipped with: 1 splinter pistol; 1 The Sceptre of Dark Millennia.
keywords: INFANTRY, CHARACTER, EPIC HERO, ARCHON, ASDRUBAEL VECT

abilities.name: Hit & Run

abilities.name: Skyboard Mastery

abilities.name: Lord of the Sky-City [AURA]
abilities.text: While a friendly Hellions unit is within 6" of this model, that unit re-rolls Charge rolls and gains +1 to its Move characteristic.

subtitle: Six-Headed Mandrake-Prince

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.text: This model can be attached to one of the following units: Mandrakes.

abilities.name: Shadow Cloak
abilities.text: This model has a 5+ Invulnerable Save. Each time a ranged attack would target this model, if the attacker is more than 12" away, the attack fails on an unmodified Hit roll of 1-3 (the shadow obscures the target).

abilities.name: Six Heads
abilities.text: Each time this model destroys an enemy Character in the Fight phase, until the end of the battle the Attacks characteristic of Decapitating Blade is increased by 1 (cumulative; up to a maximum of +5 from this ability).

abilities.name: Heart of Living Shadow
abilities.text: This model is not slowed by Difficult Terrain and treats any terrain feature as an Open terrain feature for movement purposes. In addition, this model can be set up in Strategic Reserves with no Strategic Reserves point cost.

abilities.name: Tide of Shadow [AURA]
abilities.text: While a friendly Mandrakes unit is within 6" of this model, that unit gains the [INFILTRATORS] keyword and each model in that unit can attempt to Deny the Witch as if it were a Psyker (Deny on 2D6 = 7+).

composition: 1 Kheradruakh model. This model is equipped with: 1 Decapitating Blade.
keywords: INFANTRY, CHARACTER, EPIC HERO, MANDRAKE, KHERADRUAKH

abilities.name: Open-Topped Transport
abilities.text: This model has a Transport capacity of 10 Drukhari Infantry models. Models embarked within this transport can shoot as if they were not embarked, and can disembark even if this model has Advanced (but cannot then charge that turn).

abilities.name: Shadow Field
abilities.text: This model has a 4+ Invulnerable Save. The first time this model fails an Invulnerable save in any phase, its Invulnerable save is permanently reduced to 6+ for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: Vect Commands [AURA]
abilities.text: While a friendly Drukhari unit is within 9" of this model, that unit re-rolls Hit rolls of 1. Additionally, this model and its passengers count as Vect being on the battlefield for the purposes of Supreme Overlord (the standing version of Vect cannot be fielded in the same army).

abilities.name: Night Shield
abilities.text: Each time a ranged attack with a Range of 24" or more targets this model, that attack's Range is treated as 6" shorter.

abilities.name: Flickerfield
abilities.text: Each time a ranged attack would inflict damage on this model, you may roll one D6: on a 5+ (4+ against attacks with the [BLAST] keyword), that damage is reduced to 0.
